title: Scoped S4 result: four roles do not compress noncommuting 3-cycles below four calls
body:
## Result

In the formal four-role `F2[S4]` model below, each of the eight ordered noncommuting target pairs

`diag([a], [b], [e], [e])`, with `a,b` distinct noncommuting elements of `{s1*s2, s2*s1, s2*s3, s3*s2}`,

has exact minimum paid length **four**. Every target has a direct four-call word; a complete exact search excludes words of length at most three. This is a scoped negative result for the stated alphabet, not a multiplication-bound improvement.

## Model and exact evidence

- Four arbitrary dirty scalar roles; the last two are restored exactly by the target.
- Address group `S4`, paid labels `s1=(12)`, `s2=(23)`, `s3=(34)`.
- Each paid factor is `I+([s]+[e])N` for one paid label and any of the 120 rank-one idempotents in `M4(F2)`, giving 360 factors. All are involutions; the complete inventory includes the normalized free scalar `GL4(F2)` mixing in this model.
- Exact enumeration checks all 129,600 ordered two-factor products, yielding 87,016 distinct matrices including the identity. For each of the eight targets, all 360 final-factor meets miss, excluding every three-call word because `T=ABC` and `C^2=I` imply `TC=AB`.
- The sorted complete radius-two state stream has SHA-256 `cc18ab4f9e58731f43f42ed0fd791531696836385f9435c6328cbbe36651f2f7`.
- All eight direct four-call words, a one-call positive control, 32 single-call deletion controls, a changed-target control, and the noncommutativity checks pass under exact `F2[S4]` multiplication.

## Cost and limits

The direct cost is four paid calls; the proposed improvement would have been three calls, a one-call (25%) reduction. In the formal model, scalar mixing and the added role's hosting/interface overhead have no paid-call charge; endpoint equality enforces exact restoration. No physical supplier mapping, recursive-moment change, or new `kappa` is claimed. The current selected binding-only baseline remains complex-primitive-bound.

The package pins base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the selected-record hash, selected review, source manifest, assembly certificate, and the three-register abelian predecessor. The selected frontier and frozen sources are unchanged.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/s4-noncommuting-threecycle-r4-seeda27b
```

Expected marker:

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/s4-noncommuting-threecycle-r4-seeda27b outcome=negative-result
```

The local registered replay and `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` pass. Baseline marker: `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`, with selected `kappa=836330098538459/500000000000000000` and `binding_primitive=complex`.

## Overlap and attribution

This scope is distinct from [PR #1720](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1720) and [PR #1734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1734), which use the same S4 labels at three roles but identical 4-cycle or double-transposition targets. It is also distinct from [PR #1742](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1742), which uses `UT3(F2)`, labels `{x,y}`, three roles, and a repeated central-commutator target with eight-call floor. PR #1705 uses another address group. The scoped claim and overlap notes are in [Discussion #1740](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1740).

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human review is claimed.
